messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Sev2 Pager: NodeDiskPressure triggers in gpu-pool-5, multiple runtime/modelcache pods evicted. Affected service: runtime-serve-prod. Grafana: https://grafana.example/redwood/d/serve/runtime-disk?orgId=1&from=now-30m

sasha: ack — I'm oncall. Pulling up node list and pod evict logs now.

kube-bot: Node gpu-node-42: ephemeral usage 93%. Evicted pods: runtime-serve-5, modelcache-2, modelcache-3, batch-worker-8. Kubelet logs show eviction reason=threshold, refs: /var/log/kubelet.log:line:4243

miguel: saw repeated CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS in restarted runtime pods before crash. Stack traces show nvml reset after pod comes back. Could be correlated with forced restarts during eviction.

june: customer-impact check: proxy-metrics show 502 spikes for customer-corpA and some 5xxs across low-volume customers ~10 instances. P99 latency for serve-ingest jumped from 120ms -> 950ms for ~12m.

eli: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) free ephemeral on node (truncate high-volume logs), 2) cordon gpu-node-42 and drain non-critical pods to reduce churn, 3) scale down batch-workers and checkpoint processes.

sasha: running safe disk reclaim now — deleting rotated logs older than 7d on node via debug pod + one-liners, will avoid container restarts where possible.

sasha: command I'm running:
```
kubectl -n prod debug node/gpu-node-42 --image=busybox -- chroot /host sh -c "find /var/log -type f -name '*.gz' -mtime +7 -delete; find /var/tmp/model-checkpoints -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'checkpoint-*' -mtime +14 -delete"
```

sasha: also truncating largest runtime logs instead of full delete: `truncate -s 0 /var/log/serving/worker.log` on the biggest offenders.

kube-bot: After reclaim: gpu-node-42 ephemeral usage -> 67%. Still below unique threshold but kubelet restarted some evicted pods.

miguel: restarted runtime instances are showing intermittent cuda driver resets — leaving one node with multiple restarts causes GPU isolation glitches. Recommend we avoid heavy restart storms.

mark: infra update — beginning rolling replacement of 2 nodes in gpu-pool-5 to resize ephemeral volume from 120Gi -> 220Gi. This will take ~18m per node to drain and reprovision. Scheduling now.

ops-bot: Temporary routing change applied: route 10% of traffic to fallback model-variant (cpu-hosted) for requests that previously hit affected modelcache shards. This should cut error rate by ~60% for impacted customers.

june: quick customer note: corpA SRE reported transient 502s between 15:02–15:17. We'll prepare an outbound summary after stabilizing.

eli: longer-term actions (quick list): enforce per-pod ephemeral quotas, lower default log retention on runtime images, add pre-evict cache checkpoint to object storage, and change kube eviction threshold to be more conservative for GPU nodes.

sasha: current status: reclaimed ~85GB on gpu-node-42, cordoned node, drained non-critical pods. modelcache pods moved to gpu-node-45/47. runtime pods back to Ready; a couple showed OOMKilled earlier but now stable.\n
incident-bot: Status update: 6 pods restarted, 2 pods OOMKilled earlier, 0 nodes down, error-rate peak = 2.3% (15m window). Customer-impacted: corpA (partial degrade), corpB (minor).

miguel: assigning postmortem owner -> miguel. Will draft timeline and action items. Immediate next steps: (1) finalize node replacements (mark), (2) revert traffic shift when modelcache warmups hit healthy, (3) patch runtime to better handle cuda driver resets after forced evictions.

mark: node replacements in progress — first node reprovisioned with 220Gi ephemeral and rejoined pool at 15:34. Next node in rotation.

june: agreed — I'll send the customer-facing post-incident note once we have the timeline and initial RCA.

sasha: follow-ups for oncall: add a runbook snippet for rapid ephemeral reclaim (commands we used), add alerting for persistent eviction rates >3/min on any gpu-pool, and short-term limit on rotated-log retention to 3d.

eli: +1 for runbook. Also recommend a canary change to kube eviction thresholds in staging first.

incident-bot: Pager cleared to standby at 15:37 — system metrics stable. Please update the incident channel when postmortem is filed. :white_check_mark:
